title: Note Verbale
text:
Permanent Mission of Bangladesh
to the United Nations, New York
No. PMBNY/ISA/2022
The Permanent Mission of the People’s Republic of Bangladesh to the United Nations
in New York presents its compliments to the Secretariat of the International Seabed
Authority and with reference to the latter’s note no. ISA/OLA/2022/027 dated 09
February 2022 requesting the member states to provide update of their national
legislations with respect to activities in the area, has the honor to forward herewith the
electronic copy of the ‘Territorial Waters and Maritime Zones (Amendment) Act 2021’ of
Bangladesh enacted on 07 December 2021 with respect to activities within its maritime
boundary and in the Area.
The Permanent Mission of the People’s Republic of Bangladesh to the United Nations
in New York avails itself of this opportunity to renew to the Secretariat of the International
Seabed Authority the assurances of its highest consideration.
New York, 07 April, 2022
The Secretariat of the International Seabed Authority
Kingston, Jamaica
